params.body:
## Why

Shane on production, on the password card of #564: the sentence under "Wachtwoord" sticks to the first label, the row gap of the grid is bigger than the gap between a label and its field, and the button floats under the fields without a line.

## What changed

Both new cards (own details and password) now use the same shape as the security section right below them: a header block with the title and its sentence, 20px to the first field, and the action behind a hairline. The inline margins are gone; `ui-form-grid` and `ui-field` carry the spacing, as everywhere else in the app.

Nothing else: same fields, same routes, same texts. `refresh.css` untouched.

## Tests

`ProfileOwnDetailsTest|TwoFactorTest|CompiledViewsTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|AlpineExpressionTest`: OK (32 tests, 945 assertions).
params.title: Profile: the two new cards keep the rhythm of the security section
